image_description: A side-profile view of a turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, walking on dry ground covered with leaf litter and twigs. The turtle has a high-domed, smooth, greyish-brown carapace. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small eye. The front limb is visible, appearing stout with claws. The background consists of soil, green foliage, and a palm-like plant stem.
